description: Video Duplicate Finder - find duplicate and similar videos or images by content (GUI)
notes: Upstream ships rolling nightlies: the 4.1.x release assets are re-uploaded on every build, so the manifest version is the BUILD DATE of GUI-win-x64.zip. If upstream rebuilds on the same day after Excavator ran, the hash check fails until the next Excavator pass a few hours later.
ffmpeg and ffprobe are required - scoop's ffmpeg/ffmpeg-shared on PATH satisfies this. Decline VDF's own download offer: it would drop them into the app dir, which is wiped on every update.

The scan database survives updates: on first install the seeded settings point VDF's custom database folder at ~\scoop\persist\vdf\db (a plain hardlink persist would break - VDF replaces the db file on every save). Do not clear the 'custom database folder' field in VDF settings, or the database falls back to the app dir and dies with the next update.
The nightly zip carries ~260 MB of .pdb debug symbols - they are deleted after install.
